verses.1: I saw Jehovah, and there were two leaders of the people who stood before the temple of Jehovah. They were Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the leaders of Judah, along with the captives from Jerusalem. They came to Babylon.
verses.2: There’s one good kind of food, which is like the food that comes from the fields. But there’s also one bad kind of food, which you shouldn’t eat at all.
verses.3: And the LORD said to me, “What do you see, Yeremiah?” He replied, “There are many good things, but there are also many bad things. But those bad things will not be eaten.”
verses.4: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.5: As the LORD, the God of Israel, says: “These good things are indeed known. Thus, I will know the fate of the Jews whom I sent from this place, to a land of suffering for their sake.”
verses.6: And I have set my eyes upon them for good. They shall return to this land, and they will build and plant there. I will not destroy them or destroy what they have planted.
verses.7: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am Jehovah. I will make them my people, and I will be their God, so that they may follow Me with all their hearts.
verses.8: And those wicked people who were not allowed to eat from the grain, because the LORD said, “Thus I will give you my justice, along with their rulers and all those who remain in Jerusalem in this land, and those who live in Egypt.”
verses.9: And they shall be given over to destruction and ruin by all the kings of the earth. They shall be a source of shame and disgrace in every place where Adim is located.
verses.10: And I sent upon them the plague of famine and starvation, and all kinds of destruction from above the land that I had given them and their ancestors.
